According to the previous post-meeting email discussion, the common understanding is that the traing data size is about 1GB ~ 10GB (depends on what data will be used and the number of samples) /company (one instance). The model size is about 7MB ~ 100MB /company (one instance). The possible formats to be used for the dataset are NumPy, Matlab and Parquet. The possible formats to be used for the AI/ML models are ONNX, PyTorch and TensorFlow. Final decision about format is pending on MCC. One potential issue to be discussed is the dataset file description. As point out by companies in the email discussion, in order to enable data usage across different companies, it is necessary to discuss the dataset file descriptions, e.g. scenario/configurations.
